set.body:
Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §0 P1, §4, §5 item 3.

By default ruling E stands: D1A-film and all of D1A-types and D1B are on the 1.0 path. P1a would leave D1A-film unscheduled before 1.0; P1b would resume it only after a positive H5 and requires narrowing ruling A explicitly. The plan asks for this 'at or before' the checkpoint, so it has no blocking edge.

Scope:
Record the decision; apply §4 to the film-chain beads only if P1 is adopted.

Acceptance criteria:
1. A decision note: E kept, or P1a, or P1b (P1b states the narrowed wording of ruling A).
2. If P1 is adopted, in the same change: the D1A-types slices S3-S4c, D1A-film and D1B's proofs beads are re-prioritized and re-described per plan §4; the release-gate ticket's dependencies on D1A-film, D1B and D1A-types are removed (keeping D1A S0-S2 and D1B signatures); the stability-table AC is updated.
3. If E is kept: a note says so and nothing else changes.

Gate: the owner's decision is recorded verbatim, or faithfully summarized and confirmed by the
owner, as a decision note on this bead.

Size: S (owner).
set.title: OWNER: scope decision P1 at or before the Phase 1a checkpoint (keep ruling E, or adopt P1a / P1b)
